reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Markdown output still truncates the one-time object-storage secret key in narrow terminals because it lacks a truncation-disabling override.
1 open issue - [Prevent Markdown output from truncating the one-time secret key](https://github.com/linode/linode-cli/pull/944#discussion_r4540822722) · New
What changed in this PR This PR addresses #825 by preserving one-time Object Storage secret keys in table and ASCII table output, using the CLI’s existing nontruncating renderer. **Changes:** - Adds `keys-create` overrides that fold long values instead of truncating them. - Adds narrow-terminal tests for complete creation output and unchanged listing behavior. - Documents the action-specific output behavior. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​unit/​test_overrides.py` | Tests key creation and listing output at 28 columns in both table modes. | | `linodecli/​overrides.py` | Disables truncation for `object-storage keys-create` in table and ASCII table modes. | | `AGENTS.md` | Documents preservation of the one-time secret key. |
Review effort: Max

review_comments.body: `object-storage keys-create --markdown` still truncates the one-time `secret_key` in narrow terminals: Markdown uses `_table_output()`, but neither override covers that mode. Add a separate `OutputMode.markdown` override that enables `disable_truncation`. Extend the mode parametrization in `tests/unit/test_overrides.py` and update the new `AGENTS.md` note to include Markdown.
